_comment: Per-state state-park listing URLs. Pipeline checks this on state bootstrap and prompts Franz if missing. Required for state-parks photo loader + codify-cascade enumeration. Each entry should be the authoritative state-parks-listing or parkmap page maintained by the state's DNR / Parks Dept.

CA.agency: California Department of Parks and Recreation (CDPR)

WA.agency: Washington State Parks and Recreation Commission (WSPRC)

DE.agency: Delaware Division of Parks and Recreation (DNREC DPR)

NH.agency: New Hampshire Division of Parks and Recreation (NH State Parks)

AL.agency: Alabama State Parks (Alabama Department of Conservation and Natural Resources)
AL.notes: Drupal CMS with /parks/<slug>/ URLs. State-park-specific photo loader deferred; Wikimedia handles photos state-agnostically. State dog policy is deferred to counties/cities per AL Code Title 3 (no statewide leash law).

VA.agency: Virginia State Parks (Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation)
VA.notes: Listing URL is virginia.org/things-to-do/outdoors/state-parks (tourism-maintained, photo-friendly). Agency site dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks is authoritative. State-park-specific photo loader deferred; Wikimedia + websearch handle photos state-agnostically. State dog policy deferred to localities per Va. Code § 3.2-6539 (no statewide leash law).

MA.agency: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation (DCR)
MA.notes: Static alphabetical-list page on mass.gov (Drupal-style CMS). Each park likely links to a `/locations/<slug>-state-park` detail page. Loader-friendly pattern. Dogs-in-DCR-parks guide is the state-level dog policy authority for MA state parks — feed into codify-cascade as state_dogs_policy_v1 source. Wikimedia + websearch handle photos state-agnostically meanwhile. Franz-provided 2026-06-05. MA has 726 scoreable beaches (highest of new MVP+ states).

RI.agency: Rhode Island Division of Parks and Recreation (DEM)
RI.notes: Two distinct inventory pages: /parks for state parks, /beaches for state beaches. Both likely have a clean listing → detail-page pattern (RI is small, ~30 properties total). Wikimedia + websearch handle photos state-agnostically meanwhile. Franz-provided 2026-06-05. RI has 42 scoreable beaches.

OH.notes: Server-side query-param filter: `?activity=<Type>` (e.g., `?activity=State%20Park`, `?activity=Dog%20Park`). Likely loader-friendly (URL-driven, not SPA hash). Wikimedia + websearch handle photos state-agnostically meanwhile. Franz-provided 2026-06-05. Filter pattern documented so future loader can iterate activity types.

MI.notes: SPA-style recreation search with hash-based filter (location_type GUID for 'State park' = be7f73ee757c4a9093061d7badbb7d4e). Static scrape returns shell only; would need Playwright OR the SPA's underlying API endpoint to enumerate parks. Wikimedia + websearch handle photos state-agnostically. MI has 583 scoreable beaches via GNIS Great-Lakes shore entries.

UT.agency: Utah State Parks (Utah Division of State Parks, DNR)
UT.notes: Listing URL is stateparks.utah.gov/parks (Franz-provided 2026-05-27). State law PDF at utah.gov/pmn/files/698971.pdf documents delegation to localities — no statewide leash mandate. State-park-specific photo loader deferred; Wikimedia + websearch handle photos state-agnostically. UT is inland (no coast) — beaches sourced from GNIS lake/reservoir entries (Bear Lake, Utah Lake, Great Salt Lake, Lake Powell shore).

HI.notes: Franz-provided 2026-06-06. State parks site is hawaiistateparks.org/parks (canonical listing). State-park-specific photo loader deferred; Wikimedia + websearch handle photos state-agnostically. HI is beach-heavy / dog-park-light catalog (~7 active scoreable dog parks per 2026-06-06 audit — likely reflects HI's rabies-free quarantine history suppressing dog-park infrastructure).
